title: The NRC IFC test kit, steps 1 to 5

request.text: Load duplex.ifc and connect analytics_dataset_with_levels.csv to it using GlobalId.

reply.text: Joined on GlobalId. Every CSV row names an entity in the model. 21 physical elements (entities with a rendered mesh) have no CSV row, and 52 CSV rows match an entity that has no mesh of its own. The match report counts both instead of dropping them.

request.text: Colour the model by operational carbon.

reply.text: Coloured on a viridis gradient from 14.2 to 412.0 kgCO2e/yr. Instances with no CSV row stay grey.

request.text: Now colour it by category instead.

reply.text: Nine categories, one colour each. The legend's counts, Wall 72 down to Roof and Railing at 4 each, add up to the CSV's 268 rows.

Grouped by the storey the model places each element on, not by the CSV's Level column: Level 1 has 103 elements, 17,457.0 kgCO2e/yr in total, and a mean energy intensity of 40.50; Level 2 has 93, 13,970.2, and 40.56; Roof 8, 1,767.3, and 62.04; T/FDN 14, 4,001.7, and 61.76. The second table shows why the CSV's Level is not used: for some rows it holds a door or window mark such as B103 rather than a storey.

CSV Level beside the model's storey

request.text: Chart carbon per storey for the enriched model.

reply.text: This chart reads the enriched model's storey rollups, nrc_analytics_storeys.csv, not the test kit's CSV. Its operational totals agree with the previous turn (Level 1 17,457.0, Level 2 13,970.2, T/FDN 4,001.7, Roof 1,767.3), and it adds embodied carbon A1-A3: Level 1 49,451.2, Level 2 48,696.8, T/FDN 11,761.3, Roof 5,821.0 kgCO2e. The building totals, 115,730.3 embodied and 37,196.2 operational, are in the chart title rather than a fifth pair of bars.

chart.title: Carbon per storey (synthetic); building total 115,730.3 kgCO2e embodied, 37,196.2 kgCO2e/yr operational

request.text: Read back the NRC values that were written into the enriched IFC.

reply.text: 2,441 NRC property values read back from duplex-enriched.ifc, ordered by entity, property set, and property. The first entity, #34, carries the project's Pset_NRCAnalyticsProvenance: run run-2026-09-17-01, scenario Baseline.
